classes.name: ChartDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ChartDao class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin, focusing on functions that retrieve employee data such as counts, distribution by subunit and location, and active employee statistics.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates ChartDao, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Tests the getUnassignedEmployeeCount method of ChartDao with different subunit ID filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Tests the getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit method to verify array structure and data integrity.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Tests the getEmployeeDistributionByLocation method for correct data and count.

methods.name: testGetTotalActiveEmployeeCount
methods.description: Verifies that getTotalActiveEmployeeCount returns the expected total count.
